title: Structured hire decision protocol and 7-day immersion slate
content:
Purpose:
This working doc captures a compact, reproducible protocol for hire/no-hire decisions and an operational 7-day immersion slate for new hires (first-week activities, evidence capture, and immediate success metrics). It’s intended for interview leads, hiring managers, and people-ops partners to reduce variability in decisions and accelerate new hire impact.

Context and scope:
- Applies to IC and manager hires across engineering, product, and platform teams.
- Focus: rapid, evidence-based decisioning and a prescriptive first-week immersion that removes ambiguity for managers and new hires.
- This is a living draft; please annotate with reviewer initials and Jira ticket numbers for changes.

Quick summary of process:
1) Interview loop -> evidence capture (shared rubric) -> hiring debrief (30-45m) -> decision using decision matrix -> offer/decline comms + onboarding slate created in 24h.
2) If green-for-offer, create a 7-day immersion slate and share with candidate in offer letter package; manager and buddy accept responsibility for day-level activities.

Decision protocol (step-by-step):
- Interview evidence: each interviewer must submit a 1-paragraph rationale + numeric ratings across 5 axes (Technical Skill, Problem Solving, Communication, Collaboration/Ownership, Role Fit). Ratings: 1-5.
- Calibrated anchors (examples):
  - 5 = stands out vs peers; consistently goes above bar; clear ownership examples.
  - 3 = competent and meets expectations for level; some evidence but limited scale.
  - 1 = below bar with clear gaps.
- Hiring debrief: hiring manager convenes interview panel within 24 hours of last interview. Agenda: 1) read each rationale (no interruptions), 2) score convergence (identify outliers), 3) discuss risk items and mitigations, 4) make a preliminary decision.
- Decision owners: hiring manager (final), people-ops (offer, comp guidance, reference checks), interview lead (documents evidence).
- Decision constraints: must surface at least two independent examples of past work for any 4/5 axes rated 4+ OR a compensating mitigation plan (e.g., short-term technical onboarding program).

Decision matrix (quick text version):
- Hire (green): median score >= 4 and no axis < 3. Strong examples on 3+ axes.
- Hire with conditions (yellow): median 3.5-4 OR one axis = 2 but clear mitigation (training buddy, mentor, 30/60 day outcomes). Must document plan in offer appendix.
- No hire (red): median < 3.5 or any axis = 1 with no feasible mitigation in 60 days.

Evidence capture template (interviewer checklist to paste in feedback):
- One-line role fit summary: (why this person in 15 words)
- 3x behavioral/impact examples mentioned in interview (bullet list)
- 1 technical artifact to verify (link to repo/PR/design doc or test case)
- Rating per axis: Technical | Problem Solving | Communication | Collaboration | Role Fit (1-5)
- Signals of risk (bulleted): e.g., lack of scale experience, timezone constraints, salary expectations mismatched
- Confidence level (low/medium/high) + any recommended conditions

Interview calibration checklist (pre-loop):
- Share role-specific rubric with interviewers 48h before loop (attach top 5 competencies).
- Quick 15m calibration huddle for >2-interviewer loops: align anchors with 1 example per anchor.
- Remind interviewers to collect artifacts (code, design notes) and to avoid hypotheticals without follow-up probing.

Urgent escalation rules:
- If a panel identifies a possible safety/compliance concern (IP history, NDA issues, legal flags), pause process and notify legal+people-ops immediately.
- If compensation expectations exceed the hiring band by >20% and candidate is key, raise to Head of Recruiting for a variance.

Offer packaging and timeline SLA:
- People-ops drafts offer within 24h of hiring decision.
- Manager sends hiring rationale + 7-day slate to candidate as part of onboarding preview.

7-day immersion slate (manager-owned; share in offer packet):
Day 0 (pre-start, what we send after offer acceptance):
- Welcome note, first-week schedule, Slack intro, hardware and access checklist, reading list (team wiki + top 3 PRs).
- Assign "buddy" and calendar invites for Day 1 meetings.

Day 1 (orientation + small wins):
- 09:00 Intro w/ manager (30m) — expectations, team priorities, immediate 30/60 day outcomes.
- 10:00 Team welcome (30m) + org chart lightning.
- 11:00 Buddy runthrough: dev environment + repo checkouts (90m).
- 14:00 Small onboarding task assigned (issue labeled "onboarding-small-win") — shipping this by EOD.
- 16:30 End-of-day sync w/ manager (15m) — quick debrief and blockers.

Day 2 (context + ramp):
- Deep-dive session: product architecture + stack overview (1.5h).
- Pair session with buddy on relevant codepath (2h).
- Deliverable: PR draft or structured design note to share by EOD.

Day 3 (ownerable work):
- Take ownership of a small bug/feature scoped for a half-day.
- 1:1 with cross-team stakeholder (30m).

Day 4-5 (execute + feedback loop):
- Complete onboarding task; submit PR / deploy to staging.
- Manager-run check-in for behavioral and technical signals (30m each day).
- 1st-week retrospective + success signals: PR merged, infra access verified, 3 cross-team intros complete.

Day 6-7 (stabilize and plan):
- Define 30-day learning plan with manager and buddy.
- Identify 2 measurable goals for next 30 days.

Manager/Buddy responsibilities (callouts):
- Manager: own expectations, daily check-ins Day 1-3, and first-week retrospective. Document outcomes in the candidate record.
- Buddy: environment setup, first pairing sessions, and being the primary go-to for day-to-day questions.

Immediate success metrics (first-week):
- Onboarding small-win shipped or visible PR in review.
- All core accesses provisioned (Sentry, Datadog, Github, Slack, GSuite).
- Candidate articulated 3 focus areas for next 30 days.

Documentation & artifact hygiene (people-ops to track):
- Create candidate folder in People drive with: interview rubrics, debrief notes, final decision memo, offer packet, and 7-day slate.
- Add final decision to hiring dashboard (PEOPLE-OKR tracker) within 48h.

Open questions / work items (action list):
- Build a short "conditional hire" template that includes training plan and measurable checkpoints (owner: Priya).
- Create a one-page rubric cheat-sheet for interviewers (owner: Marcus)
- Automate Slack welcome message when offer accepted (owner: EngOps)

Notes/annotations: this doc is intentionally prescriptive to reduce variance. Add comments inline when you see team-specific needs (e.g., hardware-heavy roles, sales/CS hires).

Reviewer history: Asha (author) 2025-03-18; Marcus (comments) 2025-03-22; Priya (updates) 2025-04-02.

End of doc.
